opening.argument: The offer is presented as a routine Fetch Rewards promotion for people who do not already use the service, with a stated Target or Amazon gift card tied to ordinary receipt scanning and redemption. The description explains that viewers can sign up for a gift card, scan a recent receipt, and redeem the reward. The speaker characterizes Fetch as “a rebate app, but like for gift cards,” and directs viewers to the description link for sign-up and points. The discussion of illness and NyQuil is incidental and does not establish a separate deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: If you don't have Fetch Rewards yet, sign up right now to get a FREE $3 TARGET OR AMAZON GIFT CARD. 1. Click on the link below
2. Scan any recent receipt (grocery, CVS, Target, Walmart, Walgreens, etc.) 3. Redeem your gift card!
It's like a rebate app, but like for gift cards.
